claims.claim: Normalization accepts the standalone and bounded Project-scoped chat routes, preserves full project and conversation identity, removes only an optional trailing slash, and rejects unauthorized URL forms.
Target selection retains complete normalized URL equality and exactly-one-match enforcement; insert/send guards retain full URL comparison without navigation or title/content inference.

Production changes affect only the accepted path pattern; standalone matching, attach-only behavior, surface and draft/generation guards, submission proof, and persistent duplicate dedupe logic remain unchanged.

Synthetic regression fixtures cover accepted routes, trailing slashes, malformed and encoded forms, wrong-project/same-conversation mismatches, duplicate targets, and insert/send identity changes without live Human data.

The committed delta changes only src/aios_renew/local_chat_wake.py and tests/test_local_chat_wake.py and introduces no workflow, lifecycle, publication, roadmap, live-probe, retry/failover, or second-router behavior.
